lesson: Explains how the emotions impact on personal behaviour in varying ways: Citizen-Officer Deliberation Roleplay: Competency Level 8.2.3
unique_learning_outcome: Explains how the emotions impact on personal behaviour in varying ways.
the_entrance: 5-minute introduction: The teacher greets the students and briefly reviews the previous lesson's topic. The teacher then explains that today, they will be exploring how emotions impact personal behavior in varying ways. The teacher asks students to think about a time when they felt strongly about something and how it affected their behavior. The students share their thoughts, and the teacher connects this to the topic of the lesson. The teacher then distributes the role cards and explains the activity.

assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: The teacher assesses the students' understanding of the topic through the roleplay activity and their ability to apply the concepts to real-life scenarios.
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: The teacher asks students to write a short reflection on what they learned about how emotions impact personal behavior and how they can apply this knowledge in their daily lives.
selected_activity:
Activity: Citizen-Officer Deliberation Roleplay: Competency Level 8.2.3
Approach: Students use citizen-officer deliberation roleplay to explore 'Explains how the emotions impact on personal behaviour in varying ways.'. Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Student task: Students take civic roles, respond to a shared scenario, and agree on a reasoned decision. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
Teacher facilitation: Organizes all 35 students using 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer. and monitors progress with outcome-focused prompts and time checks. Circulates across 7 teams, facilitating role execution and formatively checking progress.
Expected output: A short role-based civic decision and its reasons.
Grouping: 7 teams (7 groups of 5) with assigned roles: Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer.
